biggest_catch: There is no public official Stash signup/referral bonus with a concrete payout — the official stash.com terms page is a generic template that says bonus funds are paid 'in the dollar amount specified [above][in the bonus offer]' with no amount actually specified anywhere on the public site. The get.stash.com links circulating online are personal referral links, not official offer terms.
catches: The official stash.com/terms-and-conditions page contains only a Bonus Offers template — the payout amount field is an unfilled placeholder ('specified [above][in the bonus offer]'), not a real dollar figure.

Current public Stash promos with concrete payouts are all targeted and require a direct Stash invitation: Scholly $40 (needs a specific offer URL), 'First Swipe, Get $5' (needs an existing Personal Portfolio, Stash Banking account, and a qualifying card purchase, invitation required).
get.stash.com/[code] links are user referral links, not official offer pages — they contain no payout terms of their own.
Third-party trackers describe a Stash referral program (historically $5–$20), but those are affiliate/secondary sources, not Stash's own terms.
